decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 02 and 03 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank window or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north or west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The windows in the roof of the extension shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The materials used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension with the installation of windows to the side and rear at ground floor level.
